title: Record an e-Transfer or another payment
summary: On the booking's Money tab: Collect the rental, choose Cash, e-Transfer or another way, and record it.

steps.text: Open the booking the money is for (Bookings, or search its number), then its Money tab.
In Rental charges, press Collect (the amount) rental.
Choose Cash, e-Transfer or another way (record it).
Paid by: e-Transfer (or how it came). Leave Amount empty for the full balance; type less for a part.
Type the reference: the e-Transfer's reference number from the bank.
Press Record the rental payment. Above your single limit it waits for an Admin.
